_schema.places: One row per geographic feature, Garmin course marker, or organiser checkpoint. Use null for km columns when unknown or not applicable to that distance.
_schema.place_id: Lowercase slug; stable across screenshots (e.g. froylandsvatnet, hogstad_checkpoint).
_schema.display_name: Garmin Connect label or official organiser name (geographic proper nouns permitted).
_schema.km_sut_23: Distance along SUT 23 km course axis (Garmin or FIT-calibrated).
_schema.km_sut_43: Distance along SUT 43 km course axis.
_schema.km_sut_80: Distance along SUT 80 km course axis.
_schema.km_sut_160: Distance along SUT 160 km course axis (161 km official).
_schema.marker_number: Integer Garmin Connect course marker when visible; null otherwise.
_schema.corridor_type: One of: start, climb, descent, flat, checkpoint, landmark, lake.
_schema.source: Provenance tag, e.g. garmin_connect_screenshot_2026-06-23, race_corridors.json, strava_segment_effort.
_schema.notes: Operator context, cross-refs, disambiguation (checkpoint vs geographic feature).

places.notes: Green play-icon start on Garmin map. Shared SUT race start geography.

Named geographic asphalt road on gramstad_band downstream tail; course km ~40.0–41.0 (operator gold extends upstream to 39.7). Cross-ref dossier sector #1 Alsvik asphalt tail; S1/F0 friction lock in spatial_terrain_map_sut43.json. Sealed road corridor — not trail tread.

Very coarse gravel road tread on gramstad_band upstream of high-friction trail; course km ~33.44–33.5 under operator gold S2/F3 in spatial_terrain_map_sut43.json. Few metres immediately downstream of exposed granite bedrock band end @ km 33.42. Distinct from Gramstad area hard-pack gravel road @ km 34.6+ (S2/F1) and Paradisskaret Downhill on SUT_160.

Upstream Gramstad-area aid on SUT_43 gramstad_band — road/trail junction near Djupemyr pond and Stavstol (norgeskart pin UTM-32 E 316090.14 N 6531722.07 elev 209.4 m; panel stream_distance snap km 30.520, residual 3.8 m). Subject_A SUT43_20260418 race stop cluster km 30.515–30.546 (~438 s); Subject_B continuous traverse. Geographic cross-ref SUT_160 CP13 gramstad_1 @ course-road km 147.5 (~139 m lateral). Upstream of gramstad_drink_cp by ~4.11 km along SUT_43 forward axis.

Drink-only aid @ trail→F4504 gravel road transition (Gramstad farm sector). Operator window km 34.628–34.635; gravel-entry pin UTM-32 E 315526.13 N 6531456.32 elev 161.3 m (panel snap km 34.603, residual 2.7 m). Subject_A full stop ~105 s @ km 34.641–34.647; Subject_B no stop. Geographic cross-ref SUT_160 CP14 gramstad_2 @ course-road km 151.0 (~170 m lateral). Downstream of gramstad_food_cp by ~4.11 km along SUT_43 forward axis.

Hard-pack tractor/gravel road in Gramstad area; course km ~34.6–36.30 (F1 operator gold). Upstream transition km 34.4–34.6 F2 chunky entry. Gravel→trail exit pinned @ km 36.30 (norgeskart pin Kubbetjørn). Cross-ref dossier sector #2; overlaps Gramstad_runden and sector-reverse training FITs.

Upstream section of Vassfjellet traverse on gramstad_band; hard dirt / grass tread (not bog). Course km ~36.30–36.6 under operator gold S3/F2 in spatial_terrain_map_sut43.json. Gravel→trail transition pinned @ km 36.30 (norgeskart pin UTM-32 E 315039.07 N 6530558.66 elev 182.8 m; Gramstad gravel road S2/F1 ends; Vassfjellet tread begins).

Marsh/bog pocket on Vassfjellet traverse downstream of hard tread; course km ~36.72–36.89 under operator gold S6/F4. norgeskart.no bog/marsh symbol (light blue dashed lines) matches dashboard S6 highlight; operator HITL chunk_07 lock. Downstream of vassfjellet_traverse S3/F2 km 36.30–36.6.
